MOFFEIN_ROCKET_BODY_LORE.en:
Log - Day 432

You know what's better than a rocket launcher?NOTHING.

I've been blasting aliens, rocks, and god-knows-what-else across this forsaken planet for over a year now, and lemme tell ya, there’s no problem a well-timed explosion can't fix. Got a swarm of bugs coming at you? BOOM. Need to cross a gap? BAM. Heck, I’ve even blown up dinner a couple times. Charred meat tastes better when it’s crispy, alright?

They sent me here for my "reckless behavior." I mean, is it really reckless if I get results? Sure, I may have leveled a couple of bases by accident. Who hasn’t? You try keeping your trigger finger calm when you're holding 60 pounds of explosive fun.

Now, I’m stuck fighting off lizard-things and space bugs. But you know what? I'm having a blast (literally). Every time I hear that sweet fwoosh of a rocket sailing through the air, I know it’s gonna be a good day. And when it hits? Well, I’ve never been one for details, but the view’s always spectacular.

Sure, I might blow myself up one day. But until then, I’m taking this launcher and riding the boom all the way home.

End Log. And yeah, I blew up the recorder too. Oops.
MOFFEIN_ROCKET_BODY_LORE.zh-TW:
日誌：第432天

你知道有什麼比火箭發射器更棒嗎？沒！有！

我在這顆被遺棄的星球上炸外星人、炸石頭、炸天曉得還有什麼鬼東西，已經炸了一年多了。我跟你說，世上沒有什麼問題是一發抓準時機的爆炸解決不了的。一群蟲子朝你衝過來？轟！要跨過一道深溝？碰！說真的，我連晚餐都炸飛過好幾次。烤焦的肉就是要酥酥脆脆才好吃，懂嗎？

他們把我送來這裡，說是因為我「行事魯莽」。拜託，只要有成果，那還算魯莽嗎？好啦，我可能不小心夷平過幾座基地。誰沒幹過？等你抱著六十磅重的爆炸樂趣，再來試試看能不能讓扣扳機的手指保持冷靜。

現在我被困在這裡，跟蜥蜴怪和太空蟲子打個沒完。不過你知道嗎？我玩得爆開心（字面上的「爆」）。每次聽到火箭劃過天空那美妙的「咻——」一聲，我就知道今天會是美好的一天。至於命中的時候？嗯，我向來不太注重細節，但那景象永遠壯觀得要命。

當然，說不定哪天我會把自己給炸了。但在那之前，我會扛著這具發射器，一路乘著爆炸衝回家。

日誌結束。對啦，我把錄音機也炸了。糟糕。

MOFFEIN_ROCKET_BODY_DESCRIPTION.en:
The Rocket is a highly mobile explosives expert who deals devastating area damage.<style=cSub>

< ! > Blast jump often to traverse the map quickly and escape danger!

< ! > Your Rocket Launcher has high knockback against enemies. Use this to knock them off of ledges.

< ! > Remote Detonator is useful for hitting flying enemies, and can also be used for mobility.

< ! > Nitro Charge is great for both area damage and mobility.

< ! > Rapid Rearm can be used to skip your rocket launcher's lengthy reload time.
MOFFEIN_ROCKET_BODY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW:
火箭手是一名機動性極高的爆破專家，能造成毀滅性的範圍傷害。<style=cSub>

< ! > 多多使用爆炸跳，就能快速穿越地圖、脫離險境！

< ! > 你的火箭發射器對敵人有很強的擊退力，可以藉此把敵人轟下懸崖。

< ! > 遙控引爆器很適合用來攻擊飛行的敵人，也能用來提升機動性。

< ! > 硝化炸藥既能造成範圍傷害，也能用來移動。

< ! > 快速重裝可以讓你跳過火箭發射器漫長的裝填時間。
